description:
OptimiDoc Cloud Client enables secure document management and workflow automation through the OptimiDoc cloud platform.


The new update expands scanning capabilities into your company systems, extends the use of advanced lists, introduces a brand-new documentation, and increases reliability across the entire platform.

The REST API Destination now supports multiple request steps, enabling scanning to even more company systems. Advanced Lists have been enhanced with an extra detail field to help users pick the right option on the terminal more easily. We've also introduced a refreshed OptimiDoc documentation portal for faster and clearer guidance and delivered targeted bug fixes for greater stability.

REST API 2.0 Destination - Scan to Any System
With the new REST API Destination, you can now integrate with even more systems and deliver every document precisely where it belongs.

Whether you work with any system that supports REST API, such as a CRM, ERP, accounting solution, document repository, project platform, or any modern cloud service, you can connect it.

Advanced Lists Just Got Smarter
Administrators can now configure additional information displayed for each item in Advanced Lists beneath the main value in the embedded application. This enhancement makes it easier for users to identify the correct option, as each item can display two meaningful values instead of just a single display name.

Discover Our New, Smarter Documentation Experience
Our documentation has been completely refreshed and now it's powered by AI. You'll find clearer steps and helpful examples that guide you through every task with confidence. AI-driven search helps you get the right answers instantly, whether you're configuring workflows or solving an issue. It's cleaner, faster, and built to support your daily work with zero friction.

Enhanced Stability Through Targeted Bug Fixes

This release brings a range of important fixes and stability improvements across our terminal applications, cloud portal and cloud client.
